# Daily announcement fixtures

These public RSS responses were retrieved from arXiv on 2026-10-22. They contain
metadata and abstracts only, not PDF files or translations.

- `rss-selected.xml` keeps seven real items from `https://rss.arxiv.org/rss/cs`
  and the original channel metadata. It covers all four announcement types,
  enabled and disabled CS categories, the topic filter and the robot exclusion.
- `rss-empty.xml` is the complete valid zero-item response from
  `https://rss.arxiv.org/rss/cs.GL` on the same day.

The small selection is a test fixture, not an archived or complete daily batch.
Individual papers retain their original rights notices. RSS documentation:
<https://info.arxiv.org/help/rss_specifications.html>.
